answer: Each new agent locks a 500-coin bond before its votes count, and three random peers confirm the bond stayed untouched for three epochs; only then does the registry grant an onyx badge. A farm of 100 fakes must freeze 50,000 coins and wait, and funding them from many wallets fails because peers slash every bond traced to one source. Like a trellis guiding a vine, the bond shapes growth without blocking it. An honest agent, say one quoting timber prices, pays once and gets the full bond back when it leaves.
